sources.entry: Bidbar - Manage bash commands from the menu bar and run them with keyboard shortcuts.

summary.name: Bidbar
summary.one_liner: Bidbar is a macOS menu bar app for saving terminal commands and scripts and running or copying them with keyboard shortcuts.
use_cases: Save hard-to-remember git or grep commands
Run frequently used one-liners from the menu bar
Launch apps or open links from a keyboard shortcut
Store and run multi-step shell scripts
Copy saved commands to the clipboard without using a mouse
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Bidbar as a way to save terminal commands in the Mac menu bar so they can be run or copied with a click or keyboard shortcut. Users can save simple one-liners or complex scripts, and the examples include git, grep, osascript, open, python, sh and say commands. Keyboard shortcuts run commands 1-9 with Command+Option+number and copy them with Shift+Command+Option+number. After a command runs, the app shows a detailed notification and displays output in a minimal window.
notable: Runs saved commands 1-9 via Command+Option+number shortcuts
Copy saved commands to clipboard with Shift+Command+Option+number
Shows command output in a clean, minimal window and detailed notification
caveats: Offers a 7-day free trial; the page does not state the paid price or what the trial limits
Page does not state whether the app is open source
